title: Affinity sign
hints: Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
solution: Energy is released by the system when ΔE for attachment is negative.
statement:
In the course’s convention, which sign of electron affinity describes exothermic gas-phase attachment?

[_]{a}

choices: The sign must equal the ionic charge
explanations: This sign would indicate energy absorbed in the course convention.
Charge and energy are different quantities.
